description: On macOS and Linux, process a bounded WAV file from the Minutes inbox or Downloads through the transcription pipeline. Compressed/private containers and Windows fail closed without reading audio. Retained meeting-library audio is unavailable to agent surfaces. Docs: https://useminutes.app/docs/mcp/tools#tool-process_audio

file_path.description: Path to an inbox/Downloads WAV file (.wav)

language.description: Transcription language code (e.g. 'en', 'ur', 'es', 'zh'). Overrides config.toml setting.

name: process_audio
